aggregate_audit.scope: Aggregate depth/group/line keys, counts, histogram totals, all63roundedmedians,189cutofffractions and contextreceipt links; no original prediction or source-metadata rescan. Overview has no explicit site IDs, so this audit cannot independently compare site-key membership
aggregate_audit.rounding: Explorer medians3dp and legacyfrac_high4dp checked against report; fractions_by_cutoff checked exactly against integer n_high/n_common_sites

agreement_definition.estimator: numpy.corrcoef: Pearson correlation; arithmetic mean over valid pairs, rounded3dp
agreement_definition.population: Primary context-qualified annotated sites; within-cell-line only; each pair has its own shared sites
agreement_definition.bands: Disjoint20-49/50-99/100+ based on minimum reads across the two compared units
agreement_definition.group_reads: Sum eligible run read counts within each group; group score is unweighted mean of eligible run scores
agreement_definition.n_sites: Sum of matched-site observations across pairs; can repeat a site across multiple pairs
agreement_definition.contrast_to_report: Report uses Spearman per pair on cumulative>=20/50/100 populations; summary median across pairs. Values are not expected to match
agreement_definition.label_issue: App says generic Correlation/r; should explicitly name mean Pearson r, disjoint read bands, summed group reads, and paired-site observations in tooltip; must not imply Spearman or unique sites

agreement_label_resolution: After the numerical audit, app labels were clarified to mean Pearson r, disjoint bands, summed eligible-run group depth and paired-site observations; separately identifies report Spearman. No statistics changed.
limitations: Aggregate equality does not independently establish per-site key membership; original exports and full validation remain authoritative
